set -euo pipefail if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then   printf 'Missing required scanner: rg
' >&2   exit 127 fi mkdir -p target/static-audit unsafe_pattern='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])unsafe[[:space:]]*(\{|fn |trait |impl |extern |\()' log_file='target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log' if rg -n "$unsafe_pattern" crates --glob '*.rs' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/benches/**' --glob '!**/examples/**' --glob '!**/fixtures/**' --glob '!**/verification/**' --glob '!**/kani*/**' >"$log_file"; then   cat "$log_file" >&2   printf 'Forbidden first-party unsafe construct found.
' >&2   exit 1 else   rg_status="$?"   if [ "$rg_status" -eq 1 ]; then     :   else     cat "$log_file" >&2     printf 'Unsafe audit scan failed with rg status %s.
' "$rg_status" >&2     exit "$rg_status"   fi fi

set -euo pipefail export PATH="/cache/cargo-shared/bin:${PATH}" mkdir -p target/moon-locks target/fuzz-tsan flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock \   rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo fuzz build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \     --sanitizer thread \     --build-std \     >target/fuzz-tsan/build.log 2>target/fuzz-tsan/build.err \   || { cat target/fuzz-tsan/build.{log,err}; exit 1; } mapfile -t fuzz_targets < <(cargo fuzz list) if [ "${#fuzz_targets[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then   echo "cargo fuzz list returned no targets" >&2   exit 1 fi for tgt in "${fuzz_targets[@]}"; do   bin="fuzz/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/${tgt}"   if [ -x "$bin" ]; then     echo "TSAN-OK: $tgt"   else     echo "TSAN-MISSING: $tgt"     exit 1   fi done

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/kani-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks # Multiple --harness flags run in one cargo kani invocation: the # CBMC pipeline spins up once and the dep-graph fingerprint is # paid only once. Previous per-harness calls cost ~9m for the # validate crate; this form completes in seconds when the # fingerprint and goto binaries are warm. TMPDIR="$PWD/target/kani-tmp" flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/kani-vb-validate RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" timeout 25m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo kani -p vb_validate --all-features --quiet --harness kani_gate_08_valid_zero_accessors_pass --harness kani_gate_08_arbitrary_parts_valid_accessors_pass --harness kani_gate_08_arbitrary_parts_root_oob_rejected --harness kani_gate_08_arbitrary_parts_symbol_oob_rejected

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/verus-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks TMPDIR="$PWD/target/verus-tmp" flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" timeout 120m bash scripts/verify-verus.sh

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/kani-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks # Multi-harness invocation: cargo-kani accepts multiple --harness # flags (per the cargo-kani 0.x help), so the CBMC pipeline spins # up once and the dep-graph fingerprint is paid only once. Sharing # CARGO_TARGET_DIR with the validate task keeps the CBMC side # artifacts warm across tasks. TMPDIR="$PWD/target/kani-tmp" flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/kani-vb-core RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" timeout 25m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo kani --lib -p vb_core --all-features --quiet --harness kani_budget_add_dim_zero --harness kani_budget_sub_dim_zero --harness kani_aggregate_usage_zero --harness kani_try_add_budget_zero_current

bash -c '   set -euo pipefail   rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo tree -p velvet-ballistics -e features \     --all-features --format "{p} {f}" > /tmp/opencode/nightly-features.txt   rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo metadata --format-version 1 \     --all-features > /tmp/opencode/nightly-features-metadata.json   echo "[nightly-feature-cargo-probe] OK: cargo-driven feature enumeration complete." '

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/supply-chain/geiger run_logged() {   log_file="$1"   shift   if ! "$@" >"$log_file" 2>&1; then     cat "$log_file"     return 1   fi }  run_logged target/supply-chain/audit.log timeout 2m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo audit --quiet run_logged target/supply-chain/deny.log timeout 5m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo deny check --hide-inclusion-graph run_logged target/supply-chain/vet.log timeout 5m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo vet --store-path supply-chain --locked --verbose error run_geiger() {   package="$1"   package_target_dir="target/supply-chain/geiger/$package"   mkdir -p "$package_target_dir"   # cargo-geiger rejects a virtual manifest as the root, so run it from   # the package's own directory (each package has its own Cargo.toml).   # cargo-geiger 0.13.0 exits 1 on `Dependency file was never scanned`   # warnings for private.rs files generated by serde/thiserror build   # scripts in target/. Those warnings are noise, not signal: the   # first-party and transitive unsafe inventory is still complete in   # the report. Accept the run when the GitHubMarkdown report was   # produced, even if geiger exited 1 on warnings.   package_dir="crates/${package//velvet-ballistics-workspace-tests/workspace_tests}"   if [[ "$package" == "velvet-ballistics" ]]; then     package_dir="crates/velvet_ballistics"   elif [[ "$package" == "velvet-ballistics-workspace-tests" ]]; then     package_dir="crates/workspace_tests"   elif [[ "$package" == "velvet-ballistics-fuzz" ]]; then     package_dir="fuzz"   fi   set +e   CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$package_target_dir" timeout --kill-after=10s 90s bash -c "cd '$package_dir' && rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo geiger --all-features --all-dependencies --include-tests --output-format GitHubMarkdown" >"target/supply-chain/geiger/$package.md" 2>"target/supply-chain/geiger/$package.err"   geiger_status=$?   set -e   if [[ ! -s "target/supply-chain/geiger/$package.md" ]]; then     cat "target/supply-chain/geiger/$package.err"     return 1   fi   if [[ "$geiger_status" -ne 0 && "$geiger_status" -ne 1 ]]; then     cat "target/supply-chain/geiger/$package.err"     return 1   fi }  # Geiger execution is fail-closed. First-party unsafe is also forbidden by # workspace lints and the unsafe-audit task; transitive unsafe remains # visible here and governed by vet/deny.  for package in vb_compile vb_core vb_expr vb_yaml vb_ipc vb_runtime vb_storage vb_validate velvet-ballistics velvet-ballistics-workspace-tests velvet-ballistics-fuzz; do    run_geiger "$package"  done  run_logged target/supply-chain/machete.log timeout 2m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo machete --skip-target-dir crates/velvet_ballistics crates/vb_compile crates/vb_core crates/vb_expr crates/vb_yaml crates/vb_ipc crates/vb_runtime crates/vb_storage crates/vb_validate crates/workspace_tests fuzz # SKIPPED: first-party crates are not published to crates.io so semver-checks cannot run # run_logged target/supply-chain/semver.log timeout 5m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo semver-checks check-release # SKIPPED: requires published crate for diff baseline # run_logged target/supply-chain/public-api.log timeout 5m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo public-api diff # SKIPPED: bloat is informational only and fails on workspace with deferred crates # run_logged target/supply-chain/bloat.log timeout 5m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo bloat --release --crates

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/loom-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks TMPDIR="$PWD/target/loom-tmp" flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings --cfg loom" timeout 10m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo test --quiet -p vb_runtime --lib --all-features models::loom

set -euo pipefail export PATH="/cache/cargo-shared/bin:${PATH}" mkdir -p target/moon-locks target/fuzz-regress if ! flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo fuzz build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu >target/fuzz-regress/build.log 2>target/fuzz-regress/build.err; then   cat target/fuzz-regress/build.log   cat target/fuzz-regress/build.err   exit 1 fi rc=0 while IFS= read -r artifact; do   tgt=$(basename "$(dirname "$artifact")")   bin="fuzz/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/${tgt}"   if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then     echo "MISSING: $tgt (binary required for $artifact)"     rc=1     continue   fi   echo "REPLAY: $artifact via $tgt"   if timeout 5s "$bin" "$artifact" >"target/fuzz-regress/${tgt}.log" 2>&1; then     echo "PASS: $artifact"   else     echo "REGRESSION: $artifact"     cat "target/fuzz-regress/${tgt}.log"     rc=1   fi done < <(find fuzz/artifacts -type f \( -name 'crash-*' -o -name 'oom-*' -o -name 'leak-*' -o -name 'timeout-*' \) 2>/dev/null || true) exit "$rc"

set -euo pipefail export PATH="/cache/cargo-shared/bin:${PATH}" mkdir -p target/moon-locks flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock \   rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo test --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --all-features \     --test proptest_digest_coherence \     --test proptest_ipc_error_exhaustiveness \     --test proptest_journal_error_exhaustiveness \     --test proptest_roundtrip_determinism

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/tlc-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks if command -v tlc >/dev/null 2>&1; then   TLC=(tlc) elif [ -n "${TLA2TOOLS_JAR:-}" ] && [ -f "$TLA2TOOLS_JAR" ]; then   TLC=(java -jar "$TLA2TOOLS_JAR") else   echo "Missing TLC runner: install a tlc wrapper or set TLA2TOOLS_JAR to an existing tla2tools.jar" >&2   exit 127 fi # Run the fail-closed CI baseline root models. Heavier exploratory specs stay # outside this CI task until they have bounded, time-safe configs. for spec in \   verification/tla/WorkflowBoundedAdmission.tla \   verification/tla/IdempotencySafety.tla do   cfg="${spec%.tla}.cfg"   if [ ! -f "$spec" ]; then     echo "Missing TLC spec: $spec" >&2     exit 1   fi   if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then     echo "Missing TLC config for $spec: $cfg" >&2     exit 1   fi   model_name="${spec##*/}"   model_name="${model_name%.tla}"   meta_dir="$PWD/target/tlc-tmp/verify-tlc-${model_name}-$$"   rm -rf "$meta_dir"   mkdir -p "$meta_dir"   echo "Checking TLC model: $spec"   TMPDIR="$PWD/target/tlc-tmp" flock --exclusive target/moon-locks/tlc-runner.lock \     "${TLC[@]}" -terse -metadir "$meta_dir" -config "$cfg" "$spec" done

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/moon-locks mkdir -p target/tmp flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env TMPDIR="$PWD/target/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo clippy --quiet --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings -W clippy::all -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::panic_in_result_fn -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::string_slice -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::let_underscore_must_use -D clippy::await_holding_lock -D clippy::print_stdout -D clippy::print_stderr
